# https://aureliusmedia.com

> Aurelius Media is a performance marketing and AI automation agency based in India. We help brands grow through data-driven paid media, AI-powered content strategy, and full-funnel growth systems. 20+ years of experience. $15M+ in managed ad spend. 150+ clients across 25+ countries.

## What We Do

- Performance advertising: Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Programmatic
- Growth marketing: SEO, content strategy, CRO, lead generation, email/lifecycle
- AI marketing & automation: AI agents, marketing automation, AI chatbots, programmatic SEO
- Creative services: AI-generated creative, brand video, UGC, reels, pitch decks

## Who We Work With

D2C brands, SaaS companies, EdTech platforms, B2B services, real estate developers, authors and publishers. Typically growth-stage companies spending $10K–$500K/month on paid media.
